# @obolnetwork/obol-sdk/blst

:::caution[v3 release candidate, unreleased]

This is the reference for `@obolnetwork/obol-sdk@3.0.0-rc.12`, generated from its source and spec. Names and shapes may still change before 3.0.0, and it is not on npm `latest`. For the released SDK see the [2.x reference](../../sdk/index.md).

:::

Node-only entry with the native BLS backend over the optional peer dependency `@chainsafe/blst`. Pass it as `bls` to `verifyLock`, `isValidLock`, `assertDepositData` and the exit helpers: a 1,000-validator lock at `full` takes about 1.3 s instead of 80 s of event-loop time. No other entry imports it, and the browser build has none.

## Pure helpers {#group-helpers}

### loadBlstBackend {#loadBlstBackend}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--pure" title="Exported from the namespace, not bound on the client">namespace only</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--throws">throws 1</span></div>

Loads `@chainsafe/blst` (once) and returns the backend over it.

```ts sdk-signature
loadBlstBackend(): Promise<BlsBackend>
```

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type">Promise&lt;<a href="./types/checks#BlsBackend">BlsBackend</a>&gt;</span>

**Throws** <span class="sdk-muted">(per spec)</span> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#BLS_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE">BLS_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE</a> <span class="sdk-muted">plus the [checks every operation runs](../errors.md#checks-every-operation-runs)</span>

**Example**

```ts
import { cluster } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';
import { loadBlstBackend } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk/blst';

const native = await loadBlstBackend(); // BLS_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE without @chainsafe/blst
const result = await cluster.verifyLock(lock, { bls: native });
```

<details class="sdk-spec">
<summary>Specification: @obolnetwork/obol-sdk/blst</summary>

Node only (not in the browser build). `loadBlstBackend(): Promise<BlsBackend>` imports the optional peer dependency
`@chainsafe/blst` (2.x) on its first call (cached) and returns the backend over it; [`BLS_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE`](../errors.md#BLS_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE) when it
is not installed or its native binding does not load. `blstBackendFrom(module)` builds the same backend over a module
the caller imported. Every key and signature is decoded with full validation; `onPolynomial` compares the two
binomial-weighted sums of each `threshold`-th forward difference; batches use blst's random weights. No other entry
imports it. `test/cluster/blstCrossCheck.spec.ts` and the lock fuzz compare it with the default backend. (new in
3.0.0-rc.5)

<p class="sdk-muted">From <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/operations.md">spec/operations.md</a>.</p>

</details>

<p class="sdk-see">See also: <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/operations.md#obolnetworkobol-sdkblst">spec/operations.md</a> · <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/src/blst/index.ts#L148">source</a></p>

### blstBackendFrom {#blstBackendFrom}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--pure" title="Exported from the namespace, not bound on the client">namespace only</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--throws">throws 1</span></div>

The [`BlsBackend`](./types/checks.md#BlsBackend) over a `@chainsafe/blst` module the caller imported
itself (`import * as blst from '@chainsafe/blst'`). Every key and
signature is fully validated (subgroup checks are cheap natively); batches
use blst's random 64-bit weights.

```ts sdk-signature
blstBackendFrom(
  blst: BlstModule,
): BlsBackend
```

|---|---|---|

| <code>blst.Signature</code> | <span class="sdk-type">{ fromBytes(bytes: Uint8Array, sigValidate?: boolean): <a href="./types/blst#BlstSignature">BlstSignature</a>; }</span> |  |
| <code>blst.aggregatePublicKeys</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/blst#BlstPublicKey">BlstPublicKey</a></span> |  |
| <code>blst.verify</code> | <span class="sdk-type">boolean</span> |  |
| <code>blst.verifyMultipleAggregateSignatures</code> | <span class="sdk-type">boolean</span> |  |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/checks#BlsBackend">BlsBackend</a></span>

**Throws** <span class="sdk-muted">(per spec)</span> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#BLS_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE">BLS_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE</a> <span class="sdk-muted">plus the [checks every operation runs](../errors.md#checks-every-operation-runs)</span>

**Example**

```ts
import { blstBackendFrom } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk/blst';
import { custom } from 'viem';

// When you load @chainsafe/blst yourself (a bundler, a custom build):
const backend = blstBackendFrom(await import('@chainsafe/blst'));
```
